dataset.description: farms | devices | issues | connectivity — see list_datasets.

metric.description: A metric key of the dataset, e.g. offline_count.

groupBy.description: Up to two dimension keys: the category axis, then the series.

filters.description: Use the exact values list_datasets lists for a dimension.

field.description: A dimension key of the dataset (or a numeric filter field such as battery_pct).

timeRange.description: Relative to the data's anchor date. Omit for all time (60 days of history).

offsetDays.description: Shift the window back, e.g. 7 for "the week before".

timeBucket.description: Adds a leading period dimension — use for trends.

title.description: Short, specific, e.g. "Offline devices by farm".

chartType.description: bar/hbar for rankings (hbar when labels are long, e.g. farms), line/area for timeBucket trends, pie/donut for a share of up to ~6 parts, kpi for one number, table for detail.

compare.description: Adds the window just before as a second series — needs query.timeRange.

insight.description: One sentence on what the data shows, written after looking at it. Shown under the title.
